title: Artificial Intelligence for Cyber Security: A Practical Guide to Data Breach Prevention
description: A guide to using artificial intelligence for cybersecurity, using machine learning to detect threats, prevent breaches, and enhance data protection.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in Cyber Security, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Cyber Security for security teams, risk managers, founders, and readers tracking digital defence.
